latex.caption: No demonstrated skill beyond elapsed time or $\beta_N/l_i$ under phase control; below $\beta_N/l_i$ within shot ($-0.071$ $[-0.133, -0.010]$). Equilibrium-scalar timing baseline on Hanson's onset list with assumed negatives; no input senses the RWM. Phase-controlled AUROC 0.53--0.63 over 5 splits in 100 ms bins only: the width was fixed after an earlier run with 200 ms bins, where seed 0's forest-minus-elapsed-time margin was $-0.037$. The forest-minus-elapsed-time interval excludes zero on 1 of 5 splits and the forest-minus-$\beta_N/l_i$ interval on 0 of 5. In 2014 the forest-minus-elapsed-time difference is negative on every split in both conditional strata (high-$\beta$ and above-proxy) and ranges from $-0.047$ to $+0.025$ in primary AUROC; the 2018 run-record holdout gives $-0.049$ $[-0.073, -0.013]$ in primary AUROC. Phase control compares pairs within campaign and 100 ms bins (at least 5 slices); elapsed time measures the residual-phase floor. Primary negatives end at the last target onset: 480 positive / 5,255 assumed-negative slices (prevalence 8.37\%). Broad adds later Hanson time and 1,349 negatives from $n=2$-only shots. Cutoffs use inner-fold primary slices. Brackets: exploratory shot-bootstrap intervals at fixed predictions, unadjusted for multiplicity. Published NSTX results are a different machine and are not comparable.

compact_latex.caption: No demonstrated skill beyond elapsed time or $\beta_N/l_i$ under phase control; below $\beta_N/l_i$ within shot ($-0.071$ $[-0.133, -0.010]$). The forest uses equilibrium scalars only (no input senses the RWM). Phase control compares pairs within campaign and 100 ms bins (at least 5 slices); elapsed time is the residual-phase floor, and the forest's margin over it excludes zero on 1 of 5 splits. Reference split, 480 positive and 5,255 assumed-negative slices; pooled scores are phase-confounded. Brackets: exploratory 95\% shot-bootstrap intervals.

split_summary.caption: Phase-controlled scores and paired phase differences (top); pooled forest scores and forest-minus-elapsed-time differences (bottom). No demonstrated skill beyond elapsed time or $\beta_N/l_i$ under phase control; below $\beta_N/l_i$ within shot ($-0.071$ $[-0.133, -0.010]$). Phase-controlled AUROC 0.53--0.63 over 5 splits in 100 ms bins only: the width was fixed after an earlier run with 200 ms bins, where seed 0's forest-minus-elapsed-time margin was $-0.037$. The forest-minus-elapsed-time interval excludes zero on 1 of 5 splits and the forest-minus-$\beta_N/l_i$ interval on 0 of 5. In 2014 the forest-minus-elapsed-time difference is negative on every split in both conditional strata (high-$\beta$ and above-proxy) and ranges from $-0.047$ to $+0.025$ in primary AUROC; the 2018 run-record holdout gives $-0.049$ $[-0.073, -0.013]$ in primary AUROC. Ranges are point estimates across seeds 0--4, not confidence intervals. Brackets: exploratory 95\% shot-bootstrap intervals, unadjusted for multiplicity, at fixed predictions; individual scores use percentile intervals, paired differences use basic intervals. High-$\beta$: $\beta_N\geq0.8$ shot p95; above-proxy: $\beta_N/l_i>4$. Holdout retains four records across three dates; broad paired intervals are available for seed 0 and holdout only. The primary seed-3 lower bound rounds to $-0.000$; its unrounded value is negative.

within_shot.caption: No demonstrated skill beyond elapsed time or $\beta_N/l_i$ under phase control; below $\beta_N/l_i$ within shot ($-0.071$ $[-0.133, -0.010]$). Within-shot AUROC means on the reference split; each of 30 two-class Hanson shots receives equal weight. Within-shot model means are point estimates; differences have 95\% basic paired shot-bootstrap intervals (1,000 replicates, seed 0), unadjusted for multiplicity. Within shot, the forest is 0.020--0.071 below $\beta_N$ and $\beta_N/l_i$ on both masks (1 of 4 unadjusted intervals exclude zero). Elapsed time's 0.931 is an artefact of the primary mask's cutoff at the last onset. Phase control uses primary positive-negative pairs within campaign and 100 ms elapsed-time bins, weighted by pair counts. Individual phase intervals are percentile; all three basic paired forest-minus-scalar phase intervals include zero. One-class cells are omitted; phase resampling is stratified by campaign.

campaign_pairs.caption: Forest minus elapsed time by campaign. Brackets: exploratory 95\% basic paired shot-bootstrap intervals (1,000 resamples), conditional on fixed fitted predictions, unadjusted for multiplicity. High-$\beta$: $\beta_N\geq0.8$ shot p95; above-proxy: $\beta_N/l_i>4$. All five 2014 point differences are negative in both conditional strata, while the primary 2014 differences range from $-0.047$ to $+0.025$; all five 2018 split-seed intervals include zero. The included 2018 run-record holdout intervals exclude zero: primary $-0.049$ {\scriptsize $[-0.073, -0.013]$}; high-$\beta$ $-0.070$ {\scriptsize $[-0.117, -0.010]$}.

alarms.caption: Forest alarms across all five splits and the run-record holdout. D/E/M: Detected/Early/Missed among 30 target shots. The first considered alarm decides the primary shot category; any-warning precedence is a sensitivity. Per-onset counts retain all alarms. Brackets: 95\% percentile shot-bootstrap intervals, including detection-minus-reference, conditional on fixed fitted predictions and unadjusted for multiplicity. Between-model differences elsewhere use basic paired intervals. No improvement over the approximate rate-matched random reference was established: all five difference intervals include zero; equivalence is not established. Comparison and Hanson incidences are unlabelled-shot incidences, not verified false-positive rates. Warning medians are conditional on the matching window; the reference-split median is $356$ {\scriptsize $[286, 389]$} ms, near the 400 ms limit.

onset_actual.caption: Offline EFIT inputs held at the actual listed onset (last sample age $\leq50$ ms): 5 snapshots below $\beta_N/l_i=4$; 4 missing EFIT snapshots. Missing inputs retain their own category. Elapsed time starts at the first $|I_p|\geq0.5$ MA crossing. High-$\beta$ slices are counted in the 100 ms pre-onset forecast window. The pre-onset-window snapshot is distinct from the actual onset; no post-onset extent is inferred.
